verdict.rationale: Stark Bank's own docs mention webhook events and how to handle them, so an event-driven integration exists in some form. Nothing in the pack shows which transaction state changes fire webhooks, and nothing covers balance reads reflecting holds or pending activity. missing for 10: balance endpoint semantics covering holds/pending funds, documented webhook coverage for every transaction state change, webhook registration/delivery details, independent corroboration of real-time mirroring.

support.subject: As a developer, the ledger is real-time and event-driven — balance reads that reflect holds and pending activity, and webhooks for every transaction state change so my system mirrors the bank exactly

citations.quote: Learn how to properly handle our webhook events
